name: BoreTHM benchmark dataset
description: Reference cases for checking a model of circulating temperature or borehole stability in superhot geothermal drilling against BoreTHM (https://github.com/ldocallaghan/BoreTHM). Each case gives machine-readable inputs, the expected outputs from BoreTHM’s regression results, and the tolerances its tests apply. The cases are the UT Austin insulated drill pipe comparison (Wu et al., 2025), the Utah FORGE well 16B insulated drill pipe trial and its pauses, a stability cross-check at Soultz, a reference table for five sites, and breakout-timing results for Soultz and United Downs. Matching a case shows that a calculation has been reproduced. It does not establish agreement with field observations or suitability for a particular well. The dataset is versioned separately from the software; version 1.0 was built with BoreTHM 1.4.1. BoreTHM’s results, exported inputs and documentation are licensed under CC BY 4.0. Third-party data keep their own licences: the Utah FORGE and Newberry extracts are CC BY 4.0, and the UD-1 image interpretation is under the Open Government Licence (Contains NERC materials ©NERC 2024; contains data supplied by UKRI).
